newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle slow at $105/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle slow at $105/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with few sales slaughter steers and heifers $2.00-$3.00 per cwt higher than last Friday, UADA said. Buyer inquiry and demand fairly good, seller interest limited.
Several bids of $104.00 per cwt on a dressed basis noted, cattle being offered $105.00 and higher.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225 lbs few 105.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1125 lbs few 105.00. Confirmed - 300 Last Week - 400 Last Year - None
Wk To Date - 8,200 Sm Pd Lst Wk - 9,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr - 700
